title: Cluster & Mesh Federation

modes.label: Cluster

modes.label: Mesh
modes.description: Reader & dashboard UI. Scans LAN to view and monitor other connected M3TAL nodes from your desktop.

modes.label: Node
modes.description: Headless sender daemon. Broadcasts CPU, GPU, and disk metrics without running a GUI. Ideal for servers & NAS.
